output_list.criticism: The token is bought at a price lower than its initial price. The token will be sold at a higher price, which will cause the token price to devalue. The attacker can buy the token at a low price, then sell it at a high price to gain a large amount of tokens. The attacker will not be able to sell the token at a loss because the attacker will not have enough tokens to sell. The attacker can only sell the token at a profit. The attacker can use this vulnerability to get more tokens than he/she spent on the token.
